verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://www.communityphone.org/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured product summary. Numerous excerpts show the file covers the Base device, setup, porting, plans, app/dashboard management, business features, and a coverage-check URL, so an agent can be pointed at it to learn the service. Missing for 10: deeper agent-oriented reference material (no llms-full.txt or machine-readable API/OpenAPI docs; OpenAPI paths 404), independent corroboration of the file's usefulness to agents.
